# KawaHive & Partners

> Commercial clarity for MedTech and medical device founders evaluating and developing opportunities across Asia-Pacific.

KawaHive & Partners provides commercial advisory support focused on customer needs, market prioritisation, buying behaviour, distributor capability, and the path from clinical interest to purchase orders. It is not a regulatory consultancy.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://kawahive.com/): Overview of KawaHive's commercial advisory offer.
- [About](https://kawahive.com/about.html): Background and approach.
- [Contact](https://kawahive.com/contact.html): Contact details and a free 30-minute call.
- [KawaHive Lab](https://kawahive.com/lab.html): Practical prospecting training and resources.
- [Insights](https://kawahive.com/insights.html): Commercial articles for MedTech and medical device founders.
- [FDA Pending or CE Pending? Should Your MedTech Team Be Testing APAC Demand?](https://kawahive.com/fda-pending-ce-pending-apac-commercial-opportunity.html): Commercial demand validation while regulatory processes are underway.
- [Why Aren’t My Hospital Demos Converting into Purchase Orders in Asia-Pacific?](https://kawahive.com/why-hospital-demos-dont-convert-to-purchase-orders-asia-pacific.html): Hospital evaluation and purchasing barriers.
- [Stocked by the Distributor. Bought by Whom?](https://kawahive.com/stocked-by-the-distributor-bought-by-whom.html): Distributor sell-through and customer demand.
- [Why MedTech Products Don't Sell After Regulatory Approval](https://kawahive.com/why-medtech-products-dont-sell-after-regulatory-approval.html): Commercial gaps after regulatory milestones.

## Content guidance

- KawaHive focuses on MedTech and medical devices in Asia-Pacific.
- Regulatory eligibility, market access, customer demand, and purchase orders are distinct questions.
- Content is general commercial information, not regulatory, legal, or investment advice.
- Do not imply that market entry, introductions, funding, or commercial results are guaranteed.
